releases.body:
- docs: fix invalid flat-tuple JSON in the agent install step (nested tuple is the valid form)
- docs: paste-safe reference config, trim README (EN/zh-CN), all JSON blocks validated

- feat: fully opt-in hiding — nothing is hidden by default; declare exactly what to hide via the single \hiddenDirs\ option (\hiddenDirs: []\ / plain-string registration hide nothing)
- feat: gitignored files are now listed too (the server \ignored\ flag is no longer filtered)
- docs: README rework (EN/zh-CN) around the opt-in semantics

- feat: hide common build artifact / dependency dirs (node_modules, dist, build, out, target, __pycache__) even when not git-ignored
- feat: configurable via \hiddenDirs\ (extra dirs to hide) / \isibleDirs\ (un-hide a default) plugin options
- feat: directories sort first, then files alphabetically
- refactor: ponytail cleanup (single repo-root probe, leaner error formatting, inlined open-file helper)
- docs: README rework (EN/zh-CN), config section

- Correct the install docs: OpenCode installs npm plugins with its **embedded** Bun runtime — no separate Bun install is required
- Loading-screen hang troubleshooting now points to `opencode --print-logs` and clearing `~/.cache/opencode/` (typical cause: embedded runtime stuck resolving packages behind proxies/slow networks)

- Install docs: add copy-paste "let your agent do it" prompt and step-by-step For LLM Agents instructions
- Document Bun as a prerequisite for OpenCode's npm auto-install
- Troubleshooting: TUI hanging on the loading screen when Bun is missing (silent install failure)
